description: Typography for editorial content, including headings, paragraphs, lists, links and tables.

howToUse: Use it around long text written by people: articles, documentation, terms, release notes.
Headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes and tables inside it take the theme's type. Use `measure="text"` to limit the line to a comfortable reading width.
Clean HTML that comes from outside before showing it.

keyboard.action: Prose does not receive focus. Its links do.

props.name: measure
props.description: `text` limits the line to the reading measure (`--prose-measure`) and centers it; `full` fills the whole column, for docs with a menu and table of contents beside it. Default `text`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
